title: Entitled Girl Kicks Cops, Cries For Daddy When Arrested (Police Bodycam)
description:
On May 4th, 2022, officers responded to a battery. Upon arrival, they tried to assess the situation by talking to the woman in question. Here's what happened next. Soon, the woman became very uncooperative and escalated the situation. The woman was transported to the jail for further procedures. The female was charged with battery upon a peace officer.
